MATCHED_CLUMPING_vs_ISOTROPIC_COLLAPSE.why: raising cosine to synonyms is FREE if you raise cosine to everything. Every treatment is therefore read against the isotropic global-centroid control INTERPOLATED TO THE SAME MEASURED SYNONYM COSINE. A positive A2_MINUS_matched_C_ISO is the only form in which a clumping gain is real.
